title: ASME A17.1 maximum car area (through makers and the VA)
edition: ASME A17.1 Rule 2.16.1, Table 2.16.1.1, as restated by Hollister-Whitney and VA PG 18-10
notes: A17.1 itself was not read; the table comes from makers and the VA, so findings are advisory. Rows stop at 6000 lb because the 8000 lb row differs between sources (research/16 M2). Loads are converted from pounds.

car_area.description: Maximum inside net platform area for a passenger car's rated load
